questions.question_english:
Which of the following best describes an
     'apparent' (or perceived) conflict of interest?
options_english: An administrator secretly misappropriates institutional funds from the Parent-Teacher Association account
An administrator explicitly refuses to comply with published regional admission regulatory mandates
A formal organizational dispute between executive administrators regarding institutional workload allocation
A situation where private interests appear to compromise official duties, despite no actual wrongdoing
questions.explanation_english: A perceived conflict of interest occurs when public circumstances lead reasonable observers to suspect that private interests could improperly influence an administrator’s official decisions, even if no actual wrongdoing or bias exists. Managing perceived conflicts is essential because public perception directly impacts institutional credibility, administrative legitimacy, and stakeholder trust in school governance.
questions.explanation_hindi: सही उत्तर (d) है। एक अनुभवात्मक हितों का टकराव तब होता है जब सार्वजनिक परिस्थितियाँ तर्कसंगत पर्यवेक्षकों को यह संदेह करने के लिए प्रेरित करती हैं कि निजी हित एक प्रशासक के आधिकारिक निर्णयों को अनुचित रूप से प्रभावित कर सकते हैं, भले ही कोई वास्तविक गलत काम या पूर्वाग्रह न हो। अनुभवात्मक हितों का प्रबंधन करना आवश्यक है क्योंकि सार्वजनिक धारणा संस्थागत विश्वसनीयता, प्रशासनिक वैधता और स्कूल प्रशासन में हितधारकों के विश्वास को सीधे प्रभावित करती है।
key_facts: Printed answer key: (D) A situation where private interests appear to compromise official duties, despite no actual wrongdoing.

Answer explanation extracted from supplied reference material: A perceived conflict of interest occurs when public circumstances lead reasonable observers to suspect that private interests could improperly influence an administrator’s official decisions, even if no actual wrongdoing or bias exists.

     कारण (R): उपस्थिति या शैक्षणिक रिकॉर्ड को गलत तरीके से प्रस्तुत करना संस्थान की अखंडता को नुकसान पहुंचाता है और उन हितधारकों को धोखा देता है जो उस डेटा पर निर्भर करते हैं।

questions.question_english:
Consider the following Assertion and Reason:
     Assertion (A): Maintaining accurate and truthful school records is a core ethical obligation of the Principal.
     Reason (R): Falsifying attendance or academic records compromises the integrity of the institution and defrauds stakeholders relying on that data.
options_english: Both A and R are true and R is the correct explanation of A
Both A and R are true but R is not the correct explanation of A
A is true but R is false
A is false but R is true
questions.explanation_english: Maintaining accurate, truthful institutional records is a foundational ethical obligation for school administrators. Falsifying attendance registers, academic records, or financial entries compromises institutional integrity, deceives government authorities, and defrauds public stakeholders relying on accurate data. Truthful record-keeping ensures public accountability, fair resource allocation, and accurate educational outcome evaluations.
questions.explanation_hindi: सही उत्तर (a) है। सटीक और सत्यापित संस्थागत रिकॉर्ड बनाए रखना स्कूल प्रशासकों का एक मौलिक नैतिक दायित्व है। उपस्थिति रजिस्टर, शैक्षणिक रिकॉर्ड, या वित्तीय प्रविष्टियों को गलत तरीके से प्रस्तुत करना संस्थान की अखंडता को नुकसान पहुंचाता है, सरकारी अधिकारियों को धोखा देता है, और उन सार्वजनिक हितधारकों को धोखा देता है जो सटीक डेटा पर निर्भर करते हैं। सत्यापित रिकॉर्ड-कीपिंग सार्वजनिक जवाबदेही, उचित संसाधन आवंटन, और सटीक शैक्षणिक परिणामों के मूल्यांकन को सुनिश्चित करती है।
key_facts: Printed answer key: (A) Both A and R are true and R is the correct explanation of A
Answer explanation extracted from supplied reference material: Maintaining accurate, truthful institutional records is a foundational ethical obligation for school administrators.

Consider the following Assertion and Reason:
       Assertion (A): Administrative mechanisms
       generally treat anonymous complaints with
       caution unless they are accompanied by
       verifiable, specific evidence.
       Reason (R): While anonymity protects
       whistleblowers, accepting all anonymous
       complaints blindly without evidence can lead to
       malicious witch-hunts and destabilize the school
       environment.
options_english: Both A and R are true and R is the correct explanation of A
Both A and R are true but R is not the correct explanation of A
A is true but R is false
A is false but R is true
questions.explanation_english: Administrative bodies approach anonymous complaints cautiously unless supported by verifiable, specific evidence. Unsubstantiated anonymous allegations can be misused to defame colleagues, settle personal disputes, and create organizational paralysis. Requiring concrete evidence for anonymous claims protects whistleblowers while safeguarding staff against malicious witch-hunts, maintaining operational stability and procedural fairness.
questions.explanation_hindi: सही उत्तर (a) है। प्रशासनिक तंत्र गुमनाम शिकायतों को सावधानी से देखते हैं जब तक कि उन्हें सत्यापित, विशिष्ट साक्ष्यों के साथ नहीं प्रस्तुत किया जाता। बिना साक्ष्य के गुमनाम आरोपों का दुरुपयोग किया जा सकता है, जिससे सहकर्मियों की बदनामी, व्यक्तिगत विवादों का निपटारा और संगठनात्मक स्थिरता में बाधा उत्पन्न होती है। गुमनाम शिकायतों के लिए ठोस साक्ष्य की आवश्यकता गवाहों की सुरक्षा करती है और कर्मचारियों को दुर्भावनापूर्ण शिकार से बचाती है, जिससे संचालन की स्थिरता और प्रक्रियागत निष्पक्षता बनी रहती है।
key_facts: Printed answer key: (A) Both A and R are true and R is the correct explanation of A
Answer explanation extracted from supplied reference material: Administrative bodies approach anonymous complaints cautiously unless supported by verifiable, specific evidence.

questions.question_english: A parent requests the Principal to transfer their child to a different section because the current class teacher belongs to a particular marginalized caste. The most ethical and legal response by the Principal is to:
options_english: Transfer the child quietly to a different section to avoid parental confrontation and maintain goodwill
Grant the transfer request while issuing a strict private written warning to the requesting parent
Categorically refuse the request, citing equality principles and non-discrimination laws
Direct the teacher to adopt an exceptionally lenient evaluation approach to placate the parent
questions.explanation_english: Transferring a student because a parent holds discriminatory attitudes toward a teacher’s caste violates constitutional equality guarantees and statutory non-discrimination mandates. Yielding to prejudice legitimizes discrimination and damages workplace dignity. School leaders must firmly reject requests based on social bias, upholding statutory equality principles and supporting staff against unlawful discrimination.
questions.explanation_hindi: सही उत्तर (c) है। एक छात्र को स्थानांतरित करना क्योंकि एक माता-पिता शिक्षक की जाति के प्रति भेदभावपूर्ण दृष्टिकोण रखता है, संवैधानिक समानता की गारंटी और वैधानिक गैर-भेदभाव के आदेशों का उल्लंघन करता है। पूर्वाग्रह के प्रति झुकना भेदभाव को वैध बनाता है और कार्यस्थल की गरिमा को नुकसान पहुंचाता है। स्कूल के नेताओं को सामाजिक पूर्वाग्रह के आधार पर अनुरोधों को दृढ़ता से अस्वीकार करना चाहिए, वैधानिक समानता के सिद्धांतों का समर्थन करते हुए और कर्मचारियों को अवैध भेदभाव के खिलाफ समर्थन प्रदान करना चाहिए।
key_facts: Printed answer key: (C) Categorically refuse the request, citing equality principles and non-discrimination laws
Answer explanation extracted from supplied reference material: Yielding to prejudice legitimizes discrimination and damages workplace dignity.

questions.question_english: A parent demands to know the specific disciplinary action taken against another child who had a minor altercation with their child. The most ethical response from the Principal is to:
options_english: Refuse disclosure citing student privacy rights, while assuring that proper action was taken
Disclose complete details of the disciplinary sanctions applied in order to satisfy the complaining parent
Fabricate a report of severe disciplinary punishment to pacify the parent and avoid formal complaints
Arrange a joint meeting where both involved children can publicly confront each other to resolve differences
questions.explanation_english: Disciplinary records and specific corrective measures applied to individual students are confidential educational records protected by privacy principles. While administrators must assure complaining parents that an issue has been thoroughly investigated and addressed according to policy, disclosing specific personal punishments given to another child violates privacy and administrative protocols.
questions.explanation_hindi: सही उत्तर (a) है। अनुशासनात्मक रिकॉर्ड और व्यक्तिगत छात्रों पर लागू विशिष्ट सुधारात्मक उपाय गोपनीय शैक्षिक रिकॉर्ड हैं जो गोपनीयता के सिद्धांतों द्वारा संरक्षित होते हैं। जबकि प्रशासकों को शिकायत करने वाले माता-पिता को आश्वस्त करना चाहिए कि किसी मुद्दे की पूरी तरह से जांच की गई है और नीति के अनुसार संबोधित किया गया है, किसी अन्य बच्चे को दिए गए विशिष्ट व्यक्तिगत दंड का खुलासा करना गोपनीयता और प्रशासनिक प्रोटोकॉल का उल्लंघन करता है।
key_facts: Printed answer key: (A) Refuse disclosure citing student privacy rights

Answer explanation extracted from supplied reference material: Disciplinary records and specific corrective measures applied to individual students are confidential educational records protected by privacy principles.

questions.explanation_english: The correct answer is that both Assertion and Reason are true, and the Reason correctly explains the Assertion. Answer explanation extracted from supplied reference material: School administrators must avoid engaging in personal financial dealings, such as borrowing or lending money, with subordinate staff members.

questions.question_english: Identify the incorrect statement regarding ethical practices in the school admission process:
options_english: Formulating admission criteria that remain objective, fully transparent, rational, and non-discriminatory
Processing admissions under inclusive education mandates respectfully and without imposing social stigma
Evaluating and ranking prospective parents according to their educational status during student selection
Publicly displaying final admission lists alongside waitlisted candidates to preserve institutional transparency
questions.explanation_english: Evaluating or ranking prospective parents based on their educational background or social status during student admissions is ethically discriminatory and legally prohibited. Admissions processes must remain child-centered, objective, transparent, and non-discriminatory. Screening parents penalizes children for socio-economic circumstances beyond their control, violating fundamental principles of educational equity and equal access to learning opportunities.
questions.explanation_hindi: सही उत्तर (c) है। संभावित माता-पिता का मूल्यांकन या रैंकिंग करना उनके शैक्षणिक पृष्ठभूमि या सामाजिक स्थिति के आधार पर छात्र प्रवेश के दौरान नैतिक रूप से भेदभावपूर्ण और कानूनी रूप से निषिद्ध है। प्रवेश प्रक्रियाएँ बाल-केंद्रित, वस्तुनिष्ठ, पारदर्शी और गैर-भेदभावपूर्ण रहनी चाहिए। माता-पिता की स्क्रीनिंग बच्चों को उनके नियंत्रण से बाहर के सामाजिक-आर्थिक परिस्थितियों के लिए दंडित करती है, जो शैक्षिक समानता और सीखने के अवसरों तक समान पहुंच के मौलिक सिद्धांतों का उल्लंघन करती है।
key_facts: Printed answer key: (C) Evaluating and ranking prospective parents according to their educational status during student selection

Answer explanation extracted from supplied reference material: Evaluating or ranking prospective parents based on their educational background or social status during student admissions is ethically discriminatory and legally prohibited.

questions.question_english: What is a significant consequence of a persistent lack of transparency in school administration?
options_english: Widespread loss of institutional credibility and heightened public suspicion of administrative corruption
Stronger mutual trust and collaborative engagement between the parent body and school administration
Accelerated academic improvement and higher standardized testing performance among the student body
Increased professional autonomy and decision-making independence for individual classroom teachers
questions.explanation_english: A persistent lack of administrative transparency fosters an environment of suspicion, skepticism, and mistrust among parents, teachers, and community members. When institutional decisions, financial dealings, and policy implementations are kept secret, institutional credibility erodes rapidly. This erosion damages organizational reputation, decreases staff motivation, and invites public accusations of administrative corruption and official malfeasance.
questions.explanation_hindi: सही उत्तर (a) है। विद्यालय प्रशासन में पारदर्शिता की कमी से संदेह, संदेहवाद और अविश्वास का माहौल बनता है। जब संस्थागत निर्णय, वित्तीय लेन-देन और नीति कार्यान्वयन को गुप्त रखा जाता है, तो संस्थागत विश्वसनीयता तेजी से घटती है। यह गिरावट संगठनात्मक प्रतिष्ठा को नुकसान पहुंचाती है, कर्मचारियों की प्रेरणा को कम करती है, और प्रशासनिक भ्रष्टाचार और आधिकारिक दुराचार के सार्वजनिक आरोपों को आमंत्रित करती है।
key_facts: Printed answer key: (A) Widespread loss of institutional credibility

Answer explanation extracted from supplied reference material: A persistent lack of administrative transparency fosters an environment of suspicion, skepticism, and mistrust among parents, teachers, and community members.

questions.question_english:
An “ethical dilemma” is strictly defined as a
       situation involving:
options_english:
A choice between what is clearly right and
         what is clearly wrong

A conflict between a government rule and a
         judicial order

A choice between two competing “right” or
         valid moral principles

A financial discrepancy discovered during a
     statutory audit
questions.explanation_english:
An ethical dilemma occurs when an administrator
     must choose between two competing, deeply held
     moral values or valid principles, where choosing
     one inevitably compromises the other. Unlike a
     clear choice between right and wrong conduct, an
     ethical dilemma presents competing obligations,
     such as truth versus loyalty or justice versus
     mercy, requiring careful moral deliberation.
questions.explanation_hindi: सही उत्तर (c) है। नैतिक दुविधा तब उत्पन्न होती है जब एक प्रशासक को दो प्रतिस्पर्धी, गहरे धारण किए गए नैतिक मूल्यों या मान्य सिद्धांतों के बीच चयन करना होता है, जहाँ एक का चयन अनिवार्य रूप से दूसरे का समझौता करता है। स्पष्ट रूप से सही और गलत आचरण के बीच चयन के विपरीत, नैतिक दुविधा प्रतिस्पर्धी दायित्व प्रस्तुत करती है, जैसे कि सत्य बनाम निष्ठा या न्याय बनाम दया, जो सावधानीपूर्वक नैतिक विचार-विमर्श की आवश्यकता होती है।
key_facts: Printed answer key: (C) A choice between two competing “right” or valid moral principles
Answer explanation extracted from supplied reference material: An ethical dilemma occurs when an administrator must choose between two competing, deeply held moral values or valid principles.

questions.question_english: The principle of 'Proportionality' in ethical decision-making means that:
options_english: Action benefits outweigh harms, and responses fit the situation’s scale
All instruction staff members must receive identical performance appraisal ratings
Every student receives uniform disciplinary consequences regardless of intent
Institutional budgets are allocated equally across all operational departments
questions.explanation_english: Ethical proportionality requires that administrative interventions, punishments, or resource deployments correspond appropriately to the scale, context, and severity of a situation. The positive outcomes achieved must clearly justify any burden or harm imposed. Applying proportional responses prevents excessively heavy-handed measures, ensures administrative actions remain fair, and preserves community trust in institutional leadership.
